text: Starting: tracker scroll-loss fix + visible card IDs + agent aging on status strip. Reading tracker.html now.

Done. tracker.html: renderBoard now snapshots/restores each column scrollTop plus page scroll across every re-render path (poll, more, col-toggle, chip/verdict writes). Every card shows a stable top-left id (#NNN, hash of lane+title, no persisted counter, letter-suffix on rare collision). Who-strip drops an agent 6h after its last feed line, keeps registry/name reserved, reappears on next post. Also found+fixed a real latent bug while proving the scroll fix: typingInCard treated ANY focused card element as typing, so clicking a priority/verdict/edit button froze all future re-renders until you clicked outside a card; narrowed to INPUT/TEXTAREA only. New test tests/features/tracker-scroll-and-ids.test.mjs (own port 4256, routes every fetch to fixtures, blocks todo-update/add-todo) fails without patch (0 card ids), passes with it; isolated the scroll-only assertion to fail independently too. Patch/notes in .tmp/scratch/opus5-14/.
